title: Chardonnay in sparkling wine
subtitle: The finesse of bubbles
objectives: Name other sparkling regions using it

steps.title: Champagne
steps.body: Chardonnay is about 30% of Champagne's vineyards, concentrated in the Côte des Blancs, on chalk. It brings finesse, acidity, citrus and floral notes, and the ability to age long. Grand Cru villages like Cramant, Avize, Le Mesnil-sur-Oger and Oger give some of its finest sparkling wines.

steps.title: Blanc de Blancs
steps.body: Blanc de Blancs, white from whites, is Champagne made only from white grapes, almost always Chardonnay. It's lean and citrus when young, developing brioche, hazelnut and toast with age. Salon, which makes only vintage Blanc de Blancs from Le Mesnil, and Krug's Clos du Mesnil are famous examples.
steps.highlight: Blanc de Blancs: white from whites

steps.prompt: What is Blanc de Blancs Champagne made from?
steps.explanation: Blanc de Blancs means white from whites.

steps.title: Beyond Champagne
steps.body: Chardonnay is key in traditional method wines worldwide: Franciacorta, Trentodoc, Crémant de Bourgogne, English sparkling wine, Tasmania and California. Its high acidity in cool climates and neutral fruit take on the bready, toasty notes of lees ageing well.

steps.prompt: Which are known for Chardonnay-based sparkling wine?
steps.explanation: The Mosel is known for still Riesling.

steps.title: What you learned
points: Chardonnay is about 30% of Champagne, mostly in the Côte des Blancs
Blanc de Blancs is made only from white grapes
Franciacorta, England and Tasmania also use it
